flag: none; Job A only via the hash-pinned approved list
engine: peaceai/lib/derive.ts (typed-DSL program search, ambiguity check, witness gates unread / chars / edge / far / branch / cap / rival size+2 with far probes, compile to whitelisted TS) and peaceai/lib/learned-derive.ts (issue parse, anti-credit guard, module and test text; the prose is never an input, constants come from the examples only); Job B: gradeSelf with the derived module re-checked (derivedModuleProblem) and the generated test run under TZ=UTC, America/Denver and Asia/Tokyo with an empty env; review comment: deriveReviewNote shows the derived expression and its far-probe outputs, rebuilt from the candidate's diff
scope: one new module src/<path>.ts exporting one pure function with 1-3 number / string / boolean parameters and a number / string / boolean result, plus one new test file; the issue gives only the header, a plain-prose Behavior paragraph and literal input -> output examples; the body is the smallest DSL program that fits every example, when no other program up to one node larger fits them too and the examples show every edge, the regions past the outermost edges, two examples per branch and per side of a cap, and no rival up to two nodes larger that disagrees on a probe
refusals: code or expressions in the Behavior section (anti-credit guard), a raw issue with escapes or control characters, a bad header, signature or path, non-literal or inconsistent examples, all examples with one result (derive_examples); no program within size 13 (derive_no_fit); search or memory budget spent (derive_budget); two fits within the slack that disagree on a boundary probe (derive_ambiguous); a fit the examples do not witness: derive_under_specified_<gate>[: param] for gate unread, chars, edge (both sides of every threshold, c - 1 / c / c + 1 for an equality), far (an example 100 past the last edge and before the first), branch / cap (2 examples each), rival (a program up to 2 nodes larger fits every example but differs on a near or far probe) or rival_budget; integer comparisons at values where no two examples (v, v + 1) show the result change, caps no two examples produce, string equality with a literal, and output pieces seen in fewer than two examples are never searched (no memorizing); any derived text outside the whitelist (globals, I/O, computed member access, constructor / eval / proto paths, timers) is refused before writing
